messages:
Marcos: Heads up — ACME partner flagged customers losing small carryover credits. Seems to happen when minutely device heartbeats land exactly on the hourly rollup boundary and usage=0 gets dropped by our aggregator windowing. Example payload they sent:

Marcos: ```json
{
  \"device_id\": \"edge-42\",
  \"timestamp\": 1685008800,   // exactly on the hour
  \"usage_units\": 0,
  \"event_type\": \"heartbeat\"
}
```

Alice: Oof. Is this during clock-drift windows or after DST cutover? Any repro steps from partner?

Dan: I can repro locally with that sample. Our hour-rollup job currently does group_by floor(ts / 3600) then sum(usage). We also run a dedupe that drops events considered \"no-ops\" (usage==0). That combination means presence-only heartbeats at the boundary can disappear, and downstream entitlement markers never get created.

Priya: Lost credits affects billing recon & revenue ops. If entitlements aren't created, reports show lower active-device counts -> potential under-crediting. We need a backfill plan and a risk estimate. How many customers/rows?

Mei: Ops: running quick query to find rows with usage_units=0 and ts % 3600 == 0 for hw partners in last 30d. Will paste counts shortly.

Marcos: Proposal: 1) Treat zero-usage heartbeat that falls within N seconds of an hour boundary as a \"presence marker\" instead of a no-op. Increase grace window to 15 minutes (current is 60s). 2) Backfill ledger markers for any entitlements missing in the last 30 days. 3) Provide partner with reconciliation CSV and a comms template. 4) Add metrics & tests. Thoughts?

Dan: Small change in aggregator: keep zero-usage events if event_type==heartbeat OR if theres no other non-zero event in the same aggregation key. Need to handle replays/out-of-order: mark inserted markers with origin=\"grace-fix\" so we don't double-count later. I'll write PR and include unit + integration tests.

Alice: I'll take review and ask infra for a short canary. Also add two counters: \"metering.grace_preserved\" and \"metering.grace_dropped\" so we can quantify impact.

Priya: For backfill, finance requests a CSV: account_id, meter_key, window_start, missing_marker_flag, estimated_credits_usd. If the number of accounts > 200, we'll threshold automated credits and require manual review for the tail.

Mei: Quick numbers: my dry query found 142 unique account_ids in last 30d with matching pattern. Link (internal): http://links.internal/query/5101234567 (placeholder).

PartnerBot: Ticket created: ACME-987. Partner notified with initial explanation and we asked for their raw event batch for last 30d.

Marcos: Thanks team. Action items: Dan -> PR by EOD (assign to @Alice for review), Alice -> review in 24h + add metrics, Mei -> run backfill dry-run and surface ambiguous rows, Priya -> prepare finance CSV template and comms draft, Marcos -> book 30m sync tomorrow with ACME. @Priya loop legal if we need to adjust credits policy.

Alice: :thumbsup:

Priya: Will have comms draft by noon. Will also prepare estimated USD impact for finance.

Dan: Opened PR: https://git.re/redwood/ingest/pull/1234

Mei: Backfill dry-run finished: 138/142 matched cleanly; 4 ambiguous rows missing device_id and need partner-side correlator. Exporting those now.

Marcos: We'll include a small reconcile script to highlight ambiguous rows and handoff to ACME SI. If partner approves, we'll push the patch behind a feature flag then flip after 24h canary. Closing loop here unless anyone objects.

Alice: No objections. I'll queue the review and add the canary dashboard panels.

Priya: Noted. Will draft comms and share with you all before partner sync.

Dan: Thanks, will update the PR with the origin tag and tests.

Marcos: Great job — appreciate the quick turnaround.
